Olympian, through its Hong Kong subsidiary HK Shang Ge Industrial Limited, provides integrated chip and electronic component solutions focused on automotive electronics and industrial connectivity.
Under the deal, Olympian shareholders will receive 40M Purchaser ordinary shares valued at $10 per share, implying a $400M company net value.
The transaction involves a reincorporation merger of Futurewave followed by an acquisition merger in which Olympian will become a wholly owned subsidiary of the new public company.
Olympian’s key founders will receive Class B shares carrying 10 votes per share, while other Olympian shareholders will receive Class A shares carrying one vote each.
Following closing, the new company’s board is expected to have five directors, with four appointed by Olympian and one independent director appointed by Futurewave.

title: Futurewave, Olympian announce $400M SPAC merger
